verification: No complete current-baseline hosted or local act receipt is recorded by this review. Gate definitions and prior scoped evidence are not a PASS for the current tree.

gaps.current: Preference/contact/inbox routes and transports exist, with bounded durable delivery. Emission coverage and several alternate approval paths remain incomplete; current candidates are not merged evidence.

Opt-in PostgreSQL reconciliation and planning metrics exist. Request metrics, notification exhaustion signals, alert evaluation and tracing remain incomplete at this baseline; PR #856 is a candidate only.

Ordered transactional migration ledger, schema verification, populated-data and mixed-version rehearsals exist. Down migrations are intentionally absent. No complete gate or production-capacity result for this baseline is claimed.

A PostgreSQL dump/restore drill and append-only audit chain exist. Independent checkpoint custody, deployment backups and secret copies belong to the operator. Export and scheduled verification remain candidate work. Live-ledger pruning requires a separate accepted archive/expiry design.
Connected recall roll-off exists; disconnected targets do not receive source recall metadata through the Bundle resource set. Installation packaging is not evidence of disconnected fleet operation.

The Release model does not represent the application storage/schema compatibility needed to prove that rollback is safe. Controller storage migration rehearsals do not provide that tenant-application guarantee.
Product-owned SLO monitor resources and their automatic recall policy remain unmodelled. Internal liveness probes and reconciliation metrics are different capabilities.

The Spoke chart now ships namespaced RBAC derived from call sites. This is a rendered authority floor, not a ceiling on all externally granted privileges or proof of cross-Environment Bundle isolation. Independent boundary review and exercised credential lifecycle remain outstanding.

Shape, exact image coverage and scan freshness are enforced, but a fresh supplied assessment is retained without a Hub-witnessed source binding. PR #277 deliberately closed only freshness. External suppression references must not be mistaken for internal Plan approvals; the lost trust-policy remainder is reissued separately.
